_comment: Whole-tree `mypy <repo>` strict surface, shrink-only ratchet (WI-rokup / INV-zogud). Regenerate with `scripts/check-mypy-ratchet --update-baseline`. The ramp lowers these numbers; they must never grow (see check-mypy-ratchet). `mypy_version` records the instrument these counts were measured with — comparing them against a different mypy is not a ratchet reading, so a mismatch is reported and blocks in --mode=strict.
